title: Ground floor use requirements in the Borough of Staten Island
previewText: For all C1, C2 or C4 Districts in the Borough of Staten Island, the applicable ground floor level streetscape provisions of this Chapter shall apply, except that ground floor level street frontages on wide streets, or along narrow streets where such a C1, C2 or C4 District is mapped along the entire block frontage, shall be considered Tier C street frontages.
